_meta.purpose: APPROVED diagrams and interactive examples for IRUSHY. Diagrams are inline SVG owned by this project (no third-party assets), so they can be shown instantly and safely.
_meta.whyEmpty: No diagram has been approved for IRUSHY yet. IRUSHY must not draw or describe a diagram as if it were an official textbook figure.
_meta.howToAdd: Add a validated SVG string in `svg` (no <script>, no external refs), plus topic/class/subject/language. The server re-validates the SVG at load time and drops anything unsafe.
rules: SVG only. No <script>, no <foreignObject>, no on* attributes, no external href/src.
Set approvedBy + approvedOn before removing sample-unapproved status.
